user_observation: Characters fragmented and the screen froze; the process stayed alive.
diagnosis: The v26 stride patch loaded successfully but did not make the persistent GPU-skin path safe. Stable v24 CPU skinning versus failed v25/v26 runs isolates persistent GPU skinning as the unsafe boundary without proving the remaining internal Remix defect.
required_fix: Disable persistent GPU skinning by default, restore CPU-skinned pose meshes, and require zero skin counters in v27 evidence.
